batteries: Do NOT place in general waste or recycling bins. Take to the Central E-Waste Dropoff location at 123 Main St.
plastics: Clean and dry all plastic containers. Only plastics labeled #1 and #2 are accepted in the curbside blue bin.
cardboard: Flatten all cardboard boxes. Greasy cardboard (like pizza boxes) must go in the compost or general waste, NOT recycling.
hazardous: Chemicals, paints, and motor oil must be dropped off at the Hazardous Waste Facility open every first Saturday of the month.
